captionStarter: Astros clinch the AL West at 81-81. First non-winning record to win a division in the 162-game era.
concept: Meme of the Week slide: '.500 record' text next to 'DIVISION CHAMPS' banner in the same graphic
description: The Houston Astros beat the Oakland Athletics 9-0 to finish the regular season 81-81 and clinch the AL West after the Texas Rangers lost to the Twins, becoming the first team with a non-winning record to win a division in the 162-game era.
headline: Astros clinch AL West at .500 with 9-0 win over A's
